pages.text: A seemingly living focus pouch that embeds itself deep into the wearer's body.$(br)Compared to an ordinary focus pouch, this one allows you to concentrate far more intensely when deciding which spell to cast.$(br)When holding a wand, pressing X to switch focuses or C to open the pouch will freeze the movement of nearby creatures.$(br)$(4)"When you ponder, time itself stands still."$()
